anchors.event_window: Before the US market open, Wednesday 2026-09-02 (conference call 8:30am ET same day)

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: ±7% one-day, skewed downside. No functioning options market so no hedging flow to dampen the move. The Sep-2025 Q2 comparable printed -10.00%.
key_drivers: Bar set at guidance's high end, not below it: Street $214.45M/$0.104 vs guide $214-215M/~$0.10; FY27 consensus EPS $0.49 sits at the TOP of the $0.48-0.49 guide -- no cushion, a raise is required to hold the stock flat

Earnings-decline quarter by design: Q2 guide implies non-GAAP OI ~$30M vs $38.2M LY (14% vs 18% margin), EPS $0.10 vs $0.13 (-23% y/y despite ~7% share shrink from ASR); Services guided down 13% y/y at negative 10% gross margin; Q2 FCF guided ~$10M vs $29.8M LY

Metric this trades on is cRPO, not EPS: $627.1M/+5% y/y in Q1, decelerating from +7% a year ago; needs cRPO >=6% plus Q3 subscription guide >=~$196M for the FY27 guide's implied H2 acceleration to look credible
Reaction function already proven hostile: last quarter beat revenue by ~$3M above high end and EPS by $0.02, raised FY27 subscription -- still traded -10% pre-market, closed -3.02%
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: Squeeze/floor case: SI ~14-20% of float on $1.9B cap with $442.8M cash, live $75M buyback, ~10% FCF yield; if cRPO prints +6-7% on AI-native SKU ARR (+47% y/y) and FY27 nudged up again, a de-rated stock with no sell-side upside embedded (avg PT $7.88-8.31) is the setup that gaps +6% to +16%, as in Mar-2025 and Mar-2026.
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: No dated 30/60/90-day revision table; revision direction inferred from named June-2026 PT raises only; a conflicting $217.85M Q2 consensus figure treated as stale.

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: No usable options-implied move exists (no weeklies, ~17-day first expiry, effectively zero OI). Anchor purely on realised history: median abs 6.01%, mean abs 6.79%. Expect ~7% one-day absolute, 1SD not a cap, fatter left tail. Nothing 'priced in' via options, but the equity has priced in a great deal: +58% run into the print, 15-20% above median analyst PT.
key_drivers: Squeeze fuel largely spent: short interest fell from 15.32M shares (6/15) to 9.13M (8/14 settlement, -31.2%), days-to-cover 3.4 -- the covering that powered the rally is mostly done, removing the cushion for a bad print

Crowded narrative long built on a board appointment (Microsoft's Jordi Ribas, 8/13) and Gartner MQ recognition, not numbers; FY27 guide is ~1% total revenue growth; last print was an EPS beat that still fell -3.02% on soft guidance
Sell-side offers no cushion: 9 analysts, consensus Hold, median PT $6.75 (below spot), avg $7.88; D.A. Davidson and Citi cut targets to $6.00 on 6/4
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: Thin float (~115M of 234M shares out; H&F holds ~45%) plus a live M&A narrative (Microsoft/Salesforce/SAP/Oracle/NICE named as potential buyers) and $75M buyback remaining -- on a beat with bullish AI/Microsoft commentary, the residual 9-13M short position has to cover into a shallow book with no options to hedge in.
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: No options data sourceable at all (chain genuinely illiquid). Short interest 19 days stale. Flagged spot discrepancy: anchor $8.16 vs a same-session $7.79 read (-5.12%), used anchor for run-up math.

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: ±6-8% absolute, skewed slightly downside. Nothing genuinely priced in -- no options market, no dealer hedging. Only visible positioning signal is a ~-5% flush on 2026-09-01 with no company news, partially de-risking but not removing the expectations problem.
key_drivers: Momentum with no idiosyncratic trigger: ~+22% over one month, ~+34% over six months near the 52-week high, while the only company news in 30 days was a board appointment -- reads as beta to the August software rally, not company-specific demand

Expectations bar now above the sell side: stock at ~$7.78-8.16 vs 'Hold' consensus and ~$7.88 average target; a company guiding ~1% growth has re-rated ~50% off its June ~$5.30 level -- an in-line print gives analysts nothing to upgrade into
Direct seasonal analog: ran to a 52-week high into the Sep-2025 print then fell -10.00%. Same shape this year: 52-week-high area, thin news, then an unexplained ~-5% pre-print flush on 2026-09-01
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: Short interest ~14-20% of float with no options to cover in -- shorts must buy stock. Sprinklr sandbags and has beaten its own guide repeatedly; a beat plus any subscription/FCF raise on top of the buyback and the Microsoft-AI-board narrative could force a mechanical squeeze of the +6% to +16.6% variety this name has printed twice in eight quarters.
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: No Reddit/X/StockTwits time series corroborated -- this is not a retail-crowded name. No headline found for the 2026-09-01 ~-5% move; treated as positioning/sector, not news.

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: ±6-8% one-day, down day bigger than up day. 8 sourced quarters: mean abs 6.79%, median abs 6.01%; three down prints averaged -7.4% vs +6.4% for five up prints. No sub-3% reaction since Dec 2024.
key_drivers: Unconditional base rate over 8 quarters: 5 up / 3 down (62.5% up), mean signed +1.21% -- a mild up tilt but on n=8 treated as ~50/50 before modifiers

Two thin conditional cohorts pull the other way: the fiscal-Q2/September print is 0-for-2 with the worst two reactions in the sample (-9.31%, -10.00%, the latter on a beat-and-raise); separately a +65%-in-ten-weeks run-up cohort with sell-side targets already exceeded is the classic sell-the-news setup

Structural item: the $125M ASR (of $200M authorization) was scheduled to run through ~2026-09-01 -- the mechanical bid that helped drive the summer rally expires essentially at the print, leaving only $75M discretionary
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: The down-tilt rests almost entirely on two conditional signals (n=2 September seasonal, one loose run-up cohort) against an unconditional base rate that is 62.5% UP; a fourth straight EPS beat plus a FY27 guide-up, with 14-20% short interest and $75M discretionary buyback, can push this 8-15% higher.
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: Base rate rests on 8 observations only (no reliable pre-2024-09 per-quarter data); no day-2-to-5 drift measured; no implied move exists for this event.

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: ±7-9% absolute, skewed downside tail vs the 6.0% median/6.8% mean of the last 8 quarters. Nothing priced in via options; the tape itself has already paid for a good quarter (+23.3% July, +29.1% August, +74% over twelve months) into a print with shares above the mean analyst target.
key_drivers: Peer tape is bifurcated and the punishing half is the closer match: Klaviyo beat on revenue and fell >11% on margin/guide softness; Five9 beat and still closed -4.3% on margin pressure; Freshworks beat-and-raised and fell 2.7% -- mid-cap SaaS beats not being paid this season unless the surprise is in margin/capital return

Bullish read-throughs (Salesforce +22.6% on 8/27, Sprout Social +26% on margin expansion) are real but CXM's own +29% August already borrowed much of that sector re-rating plus the Microsoft board appointment
Event-day macro is hostile: Nasdaq -1.4% on 9/1, 10y at an 18-month high, crude >$85 on renewed Iran/Hormuz tension, and CXM itself -5.1% to ~$7.79 the session before the print
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: 14.15% of float is short. In a sector where Salesforce just printed its best day in six years and Sprout Social gapped 26%, a raised FY27 outlook plus an expanded buyback is exactly the trigger producing +15-25% days in this bucket all season -- the macro read can be entirely correct and CXM can still squeeze through it.
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: No ETF/index flow data specific to CXM; no dated settlement figure behind the 14.15%-of-float short number; no single identified catalyst for the August +29% beyond the board appointment and sector beta.

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: ±8-10% absolute, wider than the 6.79%/6.01% historical anchor -- stock enters ~30% above its 50-day MA with no options market to absorb the risk. No dealer hedging flow; distribution fat-tailed and left-skewed.
key_drivers: cRPO (the real leading indicator) only +5% y/y and +1% q/q, NDR 104%, FY27 guided to +1% total/+3% subscription revenue -- Street sits exactly at guidance with no cushion, average sell-side target ($7.88) below spot
Third-in-a-row setup where a beat was not enough: Sep-2025 beat and closed -10.00%; Sep-2024 -9.31%; Jun-2026 beat and fell -3.02% on soft guidance

Squeeze fuel is spent: short interest collapsed from >30M shares/17.3% of float (mid-March) to 9.13M/5.21% (Aug 14) -- no forced-covering bid left to catch a disappointing guide, and only $75M of $200M buyback authorization remains
panel_verdicts.what_would_break_my_reversal_case: A genuine forward inflection on the page: cRPO stepping up toward high single digits, NDR above 105%, a raised FY27 subscription guide above $781.5M, or a new/expanded buyback or named Microsoft AI partnership.
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: Operating discipline is real and cheap (~10.6x EV/FCF on $150M FY27 FCF guide, ~$390M net cash) -- a clean beat plus even a token FY27 raise and fresh buyback authorization could re-rate a 0.61-beta name momentum has only just discovered; 5 of the last 8 prints were up.
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: Flagged spot discrepancy: anchor $8.16 vs a same-session $7.79 read (-5.12%), marked snippet_only. No options-implied move exists; no Q2 whisper number or cRPO consensus sourceable.

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: ±7-9% one-day, skewed downside tail. No functioning options market so nothing is priced in via vol; the last eight prints produced two >10% and one >16% reaction.
key_drivers: KPI substitution: 'customers with $1M+ subscription revenue' fell 149->141 then was dropped entirely from the Q1 FY27 release, replaced in the highlight bullets by a rising RPO figure ($1.04B, +10%)

Guidance-quality downgrade at Q1: FY27 total revenue and non-GAAP operating income both cut, while EPS was 'raised' via buyback-driven share-count reduction (244M->242M diluted), not operating improvement

Positioning: +63% in under three months to $8.16, above the ~$7.75 consensus target, 93% of the 52-week high; consensus ($0.104/$214.4M) sits exactly on the guided Q2 midpoint with no cushion. No insider open-market buying found; the June Form 4 cluster is routine RSU-vest tax withholding, not an information signal
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: Short interest ~14% of float (down from ~20% in June) with ~5.5 days to cover; a beat that lets management restore the FY27 guidance cut in June, on top of improving renewals/RPO and the Microsoft board add, squeezes this violently -- Sprinklr has done +16.6% and +6.1% off exactly this kind of setup.
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: No borrow-fee, dark-pool, Google Trends or Glassdoor data found. Reported 2026-08-04 layoff is tracker-only, no corresponding 8-K. No Form 4 open-market purchase found in the trailing twelve months.

synthesis.move_band_note: unsigned magnitude band, right-skewed; the implied move is roughly one standard deviation, not a cap
synthesis.early_prediction: No confident directional edge, though the lean is real: all seven personas score negative (-8 to -32), consensus -22.3, just short of the Lean Down band, driven by cRPO deceleration (+5% y/y, decelerating) and a FY27 guide implying only ~1% growth against a stock up ~63% into the print. Main caveat: every persona independently names the identical, specific reversal risk -- spent-but-not-gone short covering plus a possible FY27 guide restoration -- as the reason a beat could still squeeze this the way it did twice before (+16.58%, +6.05%).
synthesis.red_team_survival_note: The bearish thesis does not survive comfortably, and uniquely for this panel, the reversal case is not just red-team's -- all seven personas name a version of it as their own top_risk_to_my_call, not only the designated skeptic. Red-team's reversal_risk of 68 (weighted 1.5x, tied for the panel's highest) rests on named, cited evidence (short interest collapse from 30M to 9.1M shares, spent buyback capacity) rather than generic pessimism. Against that, the bear case itself (cRPO deceleration, guidance cut at Q1, KPI quietly dropped) is also specific and cited. Net: a coherent but genuinely contested lean, not a confident call.
synthesis.chair_override_note: certainty_tier overridden from High to Med. The anchor packet given to all seven personas carried a stale spot ($8.16, actually 2026-08-28 data) rather than the true 2026-09-01 intraday price (~$7.79, a ~5% same-day decline with no identified company news). Three personas (options-positioning, red-team, macro-peers) independently caught and flagged this discrepancy mid-analysis, but all seven's run-up/positioning framing was built against the wrong reference price -- a stale anchor misleading enough to affect the read, per synthesis-chair.md's override criteria. The corrected spot is used in this file's anchors and in the dossier. Call is NOT overridden: -22.3 is genuinely inside the Neutral band under the script's own bands (2.7pts short of Lean Down), and nudging it across that line would be exactly the 'the number feels too strong' override the reference document rules out -- notably, this is a materially different shape from a split panel: all seven scores share the same sign (unlike a genuinely mixed read), which is why certainty was High before this correction and is Med, not Low, after it.

independence_note: Seven isolated subagents; each received only the Phase-0 anchors (ticker, company, event window, session, spot, event-implied move where available, historical realised moves). None saw the stage 2 dossier, its preliminary direction score, another persona's verdict, or the chair's view.
